Evidence Law — Relevancy, Proof & Evaluation Guide

A practical, courtroom-oriented study guide to the Evidence Act as applied in criminal trials: relevancy, admissions, confessions, dying declarations, every category of witness, circumstantial evidence, burden and standard of proof, expert evidence, FIR delay, and Section 313 CrPC — with case law and a prosecution/defence checklist for each topic.

Based on U L Bhat & B G Harindranath, Relevancy, Proof and Evaluation of Evidence in Criminal Cases, 2nd edn (LexisNexis) — condensed and reorganised for courtroom use. For reference only; verify citations before relying on them in filings.
